description:
Welcome to 150 An Fiodán, Doughiska, Galway (H91 V02H)—a bright, welcoming four-bedroom end-of-terrace home that instantly feels like the perfect place to settle down. 

Extending to a comfortable 111 sq. m (1,196 sq. ft.) with an efficient C1 BER rating, this 2004-built residence boasts great curb appeal with its warm partial red-brick facade, a paved driveway with off-street parking for two cars, and convenient side gate access to the rear. 

Step inside to a light-filled entrance hall—complete with a guest downstairs toilet—that guides you into a cosy front sitting room, featuring wood-laminate flooring and a stunning Italian marble fireplace made for unwinding. Double doors lead seamlessly into a wonderful open-plan kitchen and dining space at the heart of the home. Equipped with classic cream cabinetry and tiled splashbacks, the kitchen connects to a bright dining area where double doors open out onto a low-maintenance, fully paved rear garden with a shed—creating a private, sunny spot for summer barbecues, family fun, or your morning coffee. 

Upstairs, you will find four spacious bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, including a primary bedroom with its own en-suite, as well as a main family bathroom—with all upstairs bathrooms being fully tiled. 

Life at An Fiodán puts everything you could possibly need right on your doorstep. For growing families, Merlin Woods Primary School, Merlin College Secondary School, and local creches are all just a short stroll away. Getting around couldn't be easier, with the frequent 409 bus route taking you directly into Galway City Centre or Oranmore, and quick, direct access to the M6, M17, and M18 motorways for those commuting further afield. You will love the convenience of nearby shopping at Briarhill Shopping Centre, Dunnes Stores, Lidl, and Tesco Express, while weekends can be spent exploring the scenic walking trails of Merlin Woods or enjoying the playgrounds, sports pitches, and tennis courts at Doughiska City Park. 

Best of all, major local employers like Parkmore Business Park, Ballybrit Industrial Estate, and the Galway Clinic are only minutes away, making daily travel a breeze. We don't expect a property like this to stay on the market for long. 

If you are interested in arranging a viewing, give our office a call today!
